In the rolling stock segment it supplies aluminium metro interior components such as ceilings, side walls, side window panels, door pillars, end walls, saloon doors and complete driver cab interiors to OEMs, alongside wiring harness design, control panel assembly and functional testing. risks.note: Volatility in prices of raw materials (sheet metal) can impact margins; the Company has price variance clauses with most, but not all, customers, so exposure remains for uncovered contracts.
Production planning and schedules vary with labour fluctuation, impacting on-time delivery of projects; mitigated via hiring from ITI, welding training and a dedicated Welding Training Center.

A sudden drop in demand for public transport solutions could significantly impact turnover and profitability; the Company is diversifying via domestic and export markets, and its machinery is not segment-specific so it can be redeployed for contract manufacturing in other industries.
